description: Search Fotocasa by location or paste search/property URLs. Get full listing records with price, surface, rooms, location, agency, media, new-construction projects and optional detail enrichment.

features.description: Only listings with these features. Multiple selections are combined (AND). Leave empty for no feature filter.
features.title: Features

fetchDetails.description: Fetch each listing's detail page to add energy certificate, agency phone and registrations, exact street, ground surface and extra features. Slower and more requests.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch details

location.description: City, province, district, neighborhood, street or ZIP code, e.g. Madrid, Barcelona, Sitges, 28001. Used in Search by location mode.
location.title: Location

locationType.description: Narrow ambiguous place names to a level. Auto picks the best match (usually the municipality).
locationType.title: Location type

maxDetails.description: Limit detail requests when Fetch details is on. 0 means all emitted listings.
maxDetails.title: Maximum detail pages

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted listings (1–10,000). Above ~9,900 rows the actor automatically splits the search into price buckets.
maxItems.title: Maximum listings

maxPrice.description: Server-side maximum sale price or monthly rent.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (EUR)

minPrice.description: Server-side minimum sale price or monthly rent.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (EUR)

mode.description: How to find listings: search by location, scrape Fotocasa search URLs, or scrape individual property URLs/IDs.
mode.title: Mode

monitorKey.description: Optional namespace for monitor state. Leave empty to derive it from the search filters.
monitorKey.title: Monitor key

monitorMode.description: Emit only new listings and listings whose price changed, using Actor state between runs. The state key is namespaced by monitorKey or the search filters.
monitorMode.title: Monitor mode

onlyPriceDrops.description: Only emit listings that show a price reduction.
onlyPriceDrops.title: Only price drops

operation.description: Sale, rent, room share, rent-to-buy or business transfer.
operation.title: Operation

ownerType.description: Private owners or professional agencies. Private-only uses Fotocasa's particulares path.
ownerType.title: Owner type

propertyType.description: Property category. Subtypes such as penthouses, studios and duplex are preserved instead of being collapsed into homes.
propertyType.title: Property type

propertyUrls.description: Individual Fotocasa detail URLs, new-construction project URLs, or numeric property IDs.
propertyUrls.title: Property URLs or IDs

publishedSince.description: Only keep listings published inside this window. Searches newest-first and stops at the cutoff.
publishedSince.title: Published since

rentalType.description: For rent searches only: long-term or temporary rental. Uses Fotocasa's rental path filter.
rentalType.title: Rental duration

startUrls.description: Fotocasa search URLs to scrape. Filters in each URL win over the form fields. Property URLs found here are routed to detail mode.
startUrls.title: Search URLs

title: Fotocasa Spain Sale & Rental Listings Scraper
